newsitem.title: GERMANY: Reuters German Advertising & Media Digest - May 13.
newsitem.headline: Reuters German Advertising & Media Digest - May 13.

text.p: REUTERS GERMAN ADVERTISING & MEDIA DIGEST
News from Reuters and the German press on Advertising, Marketing, Media, the Internet, Brand-name Products and Consumer Trends
ADVERTISING & MARKETING:

DUESSELDORF - Private television stations demand a change in Germany's strict advertising guidelines, making it possible for more ads to be broadcast and in different formats than the ones they are now restricted to. (Handelsblatt)

FRANKFURT - Willi Schalk, chief executive of advertising giant McCann-Erickson's German group, calls for a lifting of the ban on advertising during television news broadcasts in Germany, saying the ban leads to worse and not better news programming.
(Reuter)

FRANKFURT - Ad agency Springer & Jacoby has passed its trial period with consumer products giant Unilever and will now take over representation of the brand CD by Unilever unit Elida-Faberge. The multi-million mark account was previously held by J. Walter Thompson in Frankfurt. (Horizont)

FRANKFURT - Advertising agency Scholz & Friends says it has launched a subsidiary for digital data processing with a Hamburg lithography company. The new company, Steinhoeft Pre-Press GmbH will prepare digital data material for use in photography, lithography or printing, Scholz & Friends says, and is the product of an alliance with Oluf Stumm Olsen GmbH.
(Reuter)

DUESSELDORF - Three Hamburg-based advertising agencies have been named "Newcomers of the Year" for 1996 by the publishing company Econ-Verlag. First, second and third place awards will go to Boening & Haube, Zum goldenen Hirschen and Brand Factory respectively, at a ceremony in Duesseldorf on May 15. (Reuter)

FRANKFURT - The Frankfurt office of international advertising network Lowe & Partners says it will oversee the Internet junior website of DEKV insurance. Pumpking Projects will programme the site. (Reuter)
MEDIA & THE INTERNET:

MUNICH - German media conglomerate Bertelsmann AG and the Internet services company Lycos Inc. of the United States say they have formed a European joint venture. Lycos, a so-called search engine that allows Internet users to locate pages on the World Wide Web, and Bertelsmann plan to offer web directory services in 37 European countries in local language versions.
(Reuter)

GUTERSLOH - Media group Bertelsmann AG, scientific publisher Springer Verlag AG and Burda Holdings GmbH & Co KG say they have joined forces to develop two online medical information services. (Reuter)
MUNICH - Germany's second largest trade publishing group Weka says it plans to fuse the management of its soon-to-be acquired
Magnamedia group and DMV/Franzis. (Reuter)

FRANKFURT - The German Publishers Society (DVA) will take over the Mensch & Buero-Verlag publishing house and the magazine of the same name on July 1. DVA is a unit of the Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung GmbH. (Horizont)
BRAND-NAME PRODUCTS & MARKETS:

DUESSELDORF - Citibank Privatkunden AG says it has the largest Visa credit card programme in Germany. Company chief executive Jens Grzemski says it has increased its number of client accounts to over three million from about 300,000 at the beginning of 1996 and expects further growth this year.(Reuter)

MUNICH - Electronics group Grundig will have a new chairman for its advisory board on June 9, selected from within the group, the company says. Incumbent Christian Schwarz-Schilling had requested that he be replaced by the former chairman of arms manufacturer Krauss-Maffei AG, Burkhard Wollschlaeger. (Reuter)
PEOPLE NEWS:

COLOGNE - Advertising agency Barten & Barten has brought Werner D. Ludwig onto its management board, the company says. Ludwig was previously a member of the board of McCann-Erickson in Germany. (Reuter)
WALLDORF - Dr. Helmut Wilke will become director of distribution, marketing and professional services at Darmstaedter Software AG. (Kress)
WALLDORF - Claudia Uhr has joined publishing house Falk Verlag AG in Munich as press and public relations director. (Kress)
